serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Here you go.
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: W-What?! You traitor! 
???1: It’s 2000$, man! 
Hobo: Whatever! We don’t need you anyway!
You: The next one is 1000$
Hobo: No one is gonna betray our cause for a mere 1000$!
#Hobo.Face.scared
???2&3: I will get it! 
???2: I said it first!
???3: No! It was me!
???4: If you guys won’t take it, I will! 
Hobo: G-Guys! S-Stop! What about our cause! 
???2: Shut up, man! It’s 1000$! Only an idiot wouldn’t take it!
???5: He’s right! We are all sick of your bullshit anyway!
Hobo: T-That can’t be true…
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: If that’s how it is, give me the 1000$!
